primary.title: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
primary.summary: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam." Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. Visual perception accounts for 73 percent of errors, and more compute time doesn't fix the problem. The article Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs appeared first on The Decoder.
